استغبيت (form X)
# اِسْتَغْبَيْتُ (istaḡbaytu) /is.taɣ.baj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# اِسْتَغْبَيْتَ (istaḡbayta) /is.taɣ.baj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# اِسْتَغْبَيْتِ (istaḡbayti) /is.taɣ.baj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# اُسْتُغْبِيتُ (ustuḡbītu) /us.tuɣ.biː.tu/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
